另一个主角（另一个主角（第22页）“源石？”汪海喃喃自语。他自然知道源石是什么东西。外表与普通岩石无异，内里却可能藏着灵石、灵宝、功法，甚至上古遗物。但源石的表皮能够隔绝神识、灵气、甚至法则波动，不切开之前，谁也不知道里面是什么。与前世的赌石如出一辙。一刀穷，一刀富，一刀披麻布。但原著之中……似乎没有提到源石？他仔细回忆了一遍。萧凡的成长路线，从京城到海外，从宗师到涅槃，每一步机缘他都记得清清楚楚。确实没有源石的剧情。这么适合装逼打脸的场景，怎么会没有主角的身影呢？汪海眯起眼。“备马！”“去哪儿？”青鸢问。“东市，源石场。”……东市，四海源石场。整座源石场占地极广，四面高墙环绕，门口两尊石狮怒目圆睁，门楣上“四海源石”四个大字以金粉题写，在阳光下熠熠生辉。门前车水马龙，人来人往。有锦衣华服的世家公子，有风尘仆仆的散修武者，也有凑热闹的平头百姓。汪海带着青鸢走进大门，立刻有小厮迎了上来。“这位爷，您里边请！咱们这儿的源石分三等，普通区、精品区、至尊区，您看……”“随便看看。”汪海摆了摆手，目光扫过整座场院。“涨了！涨了！”“出绿了！玄阶上品！”“切垮了……全垮了……”人声鼎沸。就在这时，前方传来一阵喧哗。“你一个连家族继承权都排不上的废物，也配跟本公子叫板？”“就你那块石头别说地阶宝物了，能开出个黄阶就算你祖坟冒青烟！”汪海走近几步。一个锦衣华服的青年正抱着块西瓜大小的源石，满脸倨傲。旁边站着个青衣少年，容貌清秀，手里也拿着一块源石，个头小得多，只有拳头大。“赵公子，何必争这些口舌之利。”青衣少年声音不大，却清清楚楚，“你若不信，咱们赌一把就是。”“赌？怎么赌？”“你我各选一块源石，当场切开。谁的品阶高，谁就赢。输的人……”青衣少年顿了顿，嘴角勾起一抹淡淡的笑。“跪下磕三个头，叫一声爷爷。”此言一出，周围顿时炸开了锅。“好！赌了！我赌赵公子赢！”“我赌那个小兄弟赢！他那块石头品相不错！”“你瞎了？那石头表皮粗糙，纹路杂乱，一看就是废石！”汪海站在人群外，看着那个青衣少年，眉头微微皱起。这场景……怎么这么眼熟？赌石、扮猪吃虎、当众打脸……前世看过多少寻宝流小说，都是这个套路。难道又遇到主角了？……

Another Protagonist (Another Protagonist (Page 22) "Origin Stone?" Wang Hai murmured to himself. He naturally knows what the Origin Stone is. The appearance is no different from ordinary rocks, but there may be spiritual stones, spiritual treasures, skills, and even ancient relics hidden inside. However, the surface of the Origin Stone can isolate spiritual consciousness, spiritual energy, and even law fluctuations. No one knows what is inside until it is cut open. . It's exactly the same as the gambling in the previous life. But there seems to be no mention of Origin Stone in the original work? He recalled Xiao Fan's growth path from the capital to overseas, and he clearly remembered every opportunity. There is really no plot about Origin Stone. Where is the protagonist? Wang Hai narrowed his eyes. "Ready!" "Where to go?" Qingyuan asked. "Dongshi, Origin Stone Factory." The entire Origin Stone Factory covers a large area and is surrounded by high walls. The two stone lions at the door are angry, and the four characters "Si Haiyuan Stone" are inscribed in gold powder on the door. There is a lot of traffic in front of the door. Go there. There are noble men in rich clothes, casual warriors who are tired of the work, and ordinary people who are joining in the fun. Wang Hai walked into the door with Qing Yuan, and was immediately greeted by a young man. "Sir, please come in! The Origin Stones here are divided into three levels, the ordinary area, the boutique area, and the supreme area. Take a look..." "Look at it." Wang Hai waved his hand and glanced at the whole building. "It's up! It's up!" "It's green! Top grade Xuanjie!" "It's all broken down... It's all broken down..." At this moment, there was a loud noise from the front. "You are a loser who can't even claim the right to inherit the family. How can you challenge me?" "Your stone is not to mention a ground-level treasure. If you can open a yellow level, your ancestral grave will be covered in smoke!" Wang Hai. Taking a few steps closer, a young man in rich clothes was holding a piece of Origin Stone the size of a watermelon, with a proud face. Standing next to him was a handsome boy in green, who was also holding a piece of Origin Stone. He was much smaller, only as big as a fist. "Mr. Zhao, why bother with these words?" The young man in green clothes said in a low voice, but clearly, "If you don't believe it, let's take a gamble." "Bet? How to bet?" "You and I each choose a piece of Origin Stone and cut it on the spot. Whoever has the higher grade wins. The loser..." The young man in green paused, and a faint smile appeared on his lips. "Kneel down and kowtow three times, and call me grandpa." As soon as he said this, the surrounding area exploded. "Okay! Let's bet! I bet that Mr. Zhao will win!" "I bet on that little brother to win! His piece." The stone is in good condition! "Are you blind? The surface of the stone is rough and the texture is messy. It looks like a waste stone!" Wang Hai stood outside the crowd and looked at the young man in green, frowning slightly. Why does this scene look so familiar? Gambling on stones, pretending to be a pig and eating a tiger, getting slapped in the face... I have read many treasure hunting novels in my previous life, all of which are the same. Could it be that I have met the protagonist again?
